title: RickyRat's Improvements
description: This mod adds some simple QoL features, making progression a little easier.
body:
RickyRat's Improvements (RR's Improvements) adds some new items, blocks, and recipes to the game. There is sulfur, potassium nitrate, fossil ores, gunpowder, blaze rod, ghast tear, and saddle recipes, and more!

Bones can be obtained via mining fossil ore. Gunpowder cam be crafted with sulfur. Blaze rods and ghast tears are crafted using sulfur too. The mod is relatively small, but adds easier recipes for various items.
